name: com.agentboxd/mcp
title: Agentboxd
description: Real email inboxes for AI agents: send, reply, wait for mail, read OTP codes and magic links.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTBOXD_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agentboxd API key (starts with mr_). Create one at https://agentboxd.com/app/api-keys, or leave it unset and let the agent call the signup tool.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTBOXD_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Only change it for a self-hosted server.
